biography.value: Tide Lords make the Glacial Aura genuinely punishing — Frosted creatures within 15 feet immediately become Frozen, which means any enemy who has taken one hit from the Tide Lord and remains adjacent is automatically Restrained by the aura alone. Tidal Ice Lance applies cold conditions across entire lines of enemies simultaneously. Abyssal Freeze at Margin 3 begins Engulfing, encasing targets in ice rather than earth. A summoner deploying one against a formation will find the formation frozen — in every literal and tactical sense — within two rounds of engagement.

system.attacksNotes:
Abyssal Freeze [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 cold damage (Half DR); target gains Frosted + movement halved.
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage; target gains Frozen + Prone + Grappled; ongoing 12 cold damage per round; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 cold damage + Frozen + Prone + Grappled + Restrained; target begins Engulf — driven into ice at start of their next turn unless Fortitude [Hard] save.

Tidal Ice Lance [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 100 ft, 5-foot-wide line.

  • Margin 1:: 16 cold damage (12 + 4 Dex) + Frosted.
  • Margin 2: 16 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + movement halved.
  • Margin 3: 16 cold damage, DR halved (round up) + Frozen + Prone; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Glacial Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 15 feet take 8 cold damage (Half DR) and gain the Frosted condition. Creatures already Frosted within the aura gain the Frozen condition instead. Powerful Build: Tide Lord counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Permafrost: Ground within 30 feet of the Glacier Giant where it has stood for at least 1 round becomes frozen. Frozen ground is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving across it make Acrobatics [Easy] checks or fall Prone. Ice Stride: Moves across ice and snow at full speed. Creates a thin frost trail wherever it walks; surfaces within 5 feet of its path become Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Tide Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
